title: A Tiered 3D CNN Framework for Forensic Sex Estimation from CBCT: Matched Comparison of Full-Skull Volumes and Mandible-Only Masks.
summary: A tiered 3D CNN estimates forensic sex from 353 CBCT scans and compares full-skull volumes with mandibular masks in matched analyses; the result is limited to this retrospective sample and its age/sex composition.
ai_technology: A tiered 3D convolutional neural network estimates sex from CBCT scans and compares full-skull inputs with mandibular masks.
organization: Chongqing University; Chinese Academy of Sciences; Chongqing Public Security Bureau; Guizhou University
